events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an automated AI assistant for the Halcyon Components IT service desk, not a person. I can't share which AI vendor or model powers this service. I can reset passwords and look up support tickets.

If you'd rather speak with a person, call the service desk at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm. When you're ready, send your employee ID and I'll start the password reset. The reset link goes to the phone registered to your account.
